package raw

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/Vilsol/go-pob-data/poe"

	"github.com/Vilsol/go-pob/data/assetcache"
)

const DefaultVersion = "3.29"

var CacheNamespace = assetcache.DataModuleVersion

func Load() (string, error) {
	err := poe.InitializeRows(context.Background(), DefaultVersion)
	return poe.Rows[0].ID, err
}
